name: Plugins menu
author: Brett
description: Right-click (or long-press) anywhere → Plugins: Install… (a plugin browser over every archive location: axHub, the permanent one, needs its credentials; folders, https servers and other consoles can be added with their credentials, kept on the console server only; download and install from there, with the installer's own settings), Settings… (the settings browser: every installed plugin in a collapsible column and the picked plugin's own settings beside it; a dialog by default, switchable to a floating window; its own basic, style, switch and behaviour settings plus a placeholder for every parameter type), Manage (the Plugin Manager), Enable ▸ (the switched-off plugins: pick one to turn it on) and Disable ▸ (the opposite).
